description:
[Admin]

Writes one named style for a kind of page block, as a draft, into its own file, components/<block type>/<style>.css of the brand. The company's other CSS files are never changed. With remove: true it deletes the style's file; the answer lists the pages that used it. The page editor then offers the style on every block of that type; to apply it, set `styleName` on the block in page content with update_portal_configuration. It shows on the site once the stylesheet is published (publish_portal_stylesheet, `files: [file_id]` for this file alone). A name the company already uses in its own files is refused with 409.

block_type.description: The kind of block the style is for. The editor offers it only on blocks of this type.

brand_id.description: A sub-brand, from the brands document of get_portal_configuration. Leave it out for the main brand, the company's own, whose styles every sub-brand page also offers.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

css.description: The rules. Every selector must include .jm-site and the style class, starting from the `root` the guide gives plus the class: `.jm-site .jm-block--hero.jm-style-dark-band h1 { ... }`. @media, @supports and @container are fine; @import, @font-face and "<" are not. Required unless remove is true.

description.description: One line on what the style is for, kept as a comment above it.

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name.description: What the editor calls the style. Saving the same block type and name again replaces it. Its file is components/<block_type>/<the name as a slug>.css.

portal.description: `interview` (career and interview portal) or `consumer` (coaching portal). Only the interview portal has brands.

remove.description: true deletes the style and its file. Blocks that use it (the guide lists the pages) keep the name and show the standard look once the stylesheet is published.

name: Save_a_component_style

file_id.description: Pass it in `files` to publish_portal_stylesheet to publish this file alone. Null after a removal, which deletes the file.

live.description: Always false: this is a draft until the stylesheet is published.

pages.description: After a removal: the pages that used the style, whose blocks now show the standard look.

brand_id.description: Its sub-brand; null for the main brand.

published.description: The published page uses the style.

slug.description: Its address; built-in pages start with "_", the home page is empty.

title.description: Its title in the first language.

style_name.description: The value to set as `styleName` on a block in page content.

title: Portal Component Styles
